description: Read the Bhagavad Gita from BhagavadGita.com's official API: all eighteen chapters and 701 verses, with the Sanskrit, the transliteration, each word's meaning, and your pick of seven translations: five in English, two in Hindi. Quote a verse by chapter and verse, read a whole chapter straight through, or list the chapters with a summary of each. Pick a verse from a list rather than looking up a reference, and add a commentary to get a teacher's reading beside it, including the classical Sanskrit commentaries of Shankaracharya, Ramanujacharya and eleven others. Free.
